Mine is simply a reversal of the government system; local government being the strongest and every tier above them serves mostly as the middle-man/tie breaker between the tiers beneath it, as well as handling the programs that need a larger pool of resources.

Education would be split into two categories; a free general education that benefits everyone throughout their lives and a career based education that is price adjusted to societies needs to encourage students to pick those fields.
